title: Scientist X lecture at University of Denver

tellings.quote: On March 8th, 1950, Newton took the stage as [music] the mysterious scientist X.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how on March 8, 1950, a man named Silas Newton took the stage at the University of Denver in Colorado as a mysterious speaker called "Scientist X." Michels tells it in an episode about crashed craft and alien bodies, linking it to names such as George Koehler, Francis Broman and John Torrance Tate, as an early public claim that such crashes had happened.
